cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='modules/byte_program.py'
src=open(path).read()
start = src.index('def find_lf(node, lo, hi):')
end = src.index('def next_lf(node, start=0, limit=None):')
new = '''def find_lf(node, lo, hi):
    """First LF in ``node[lo:hi)`` as a node-relative index, else -1.

    Concatenations are walked lazily (one child at a time) so a wide capture
    stops at the first hit instead of enumerating the whole search window.
    Positions stay in ``node`` coordinates while descending through slices,
    repetitions and concatenations.
    """
    if hi > node.n:
        hi = node.n
    if hi <= lo:
        return -1
    best = -1
    stack = [(node, lo, hi, 0)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if len(item) == 6:
            current, index, stop, a, b, base = item
            kids, offs = current.flat()
            if index >= stop:
                continue
            offset = offs[index]
            start = offset if offset > a else a
            if best >= 0 and base + start >= best:
                continue
            stack.append((current, index + 1, stop, a, b, base))
            low = start - offset
            high = (b if b < offs[index + 1] else offs[index + 1]) - offset
            if low < high:
                stack.append((kids[index], low, high, base + offset))
            continue
        current, a, b, base = item
        if a >= b:
            continue
        if best >= 0 and base + a >= best:
            continue
        kind = type(current)
        if kind is Lit:
            found = current.data.find(LF, a, b)
            if found >= 0 and (best < 0 or base + found < best):
                best = base + found
        elif kind is Cut:
            stack.append((current.kid, a + current.lo, b + current.lo,
                          base - current.lo))
        elif kind is Cat:
            kids, offs = current.flat()
            first = bisect_right(offs, a) - 1
            if first < 0:
                first = 0
            last = bisect_left(offs, b) - 1
            if last >= len(kids):
                last = len(kids) - 1
            if first <= last:
                stack.append((current, first, last + 1, a, b, base))
        elif kind is Rep:
            period = current.kid.n
            if period == 0:
                continue
            copy = a // period
            inner = a - copy * period
            limit = b - copy * period
            if limit > period:
                limit = period
            if inner < limit:
                stack.append((current.kid, inner, limit, base + copy * period))
            if b > (copy + 1) * period:
                inside = first_lf(current.kid)
                if inside >= 0:
                    found = (copy + 1) * period + inside
                    if found < b and (best < 0 or base + found < best):
                        best = base + found
        else:
            raise ValueError('unknown node')
    return best


'''
src = src[:start] + new + src[end:]
open(path,'w').write(src)
